terrain.title: Off the flat track
terrain.lead: Since 2016, RoboRacer has raced on flat floors. The next tracks rise and fall.

car.title: A first look
car.lead: A retrofit of the RoboRacer car, not a redesign. Full specs later.
car.alt: The RoboRacer off-road car turning on a dark stage, from one front quarter past its face to the other: a stereo camera and two antennas on top, knobby tires, red shocks

callouts.title: Vision-based
callouts.body: Stereo cameras see the track in 3D.

callouts.title: 3D positioning
callouts.body: Visual-inertial: the cameras plus an IMU.

callouts.title: 3D planning
callouts.body: It plans its path over the terrain.

callouts.title: 1/10 scale
callouts.body: Still 1/10, with more compute on board.

items.title: The simulator
items.body: Test your code on hilly terrain.

image.alt: A simulated RoboRacer car on a wavy asphalt track over grassy hills, trees behind
The car's live map of an indoor track, turned to fill the frame: the planned route, its position and the point cloud it builds
